title: Older BAE archives colleague with TS/SCI warned him

tellings.quote: one of the older guys who uh worked for archives had a TSSCI and made his way to the intelligence community as a government employee.

plain: A former worker at BAE, a large defense company, says an older colleague in its archives department, who held a top-level security clearance known as TS/SCI and later moved into the intelligence agencies as a government employee, gave him a warning. Dylan Borland tells this to Michels as something that happened to him directly. He tells it as a sign that people with deep clearances knew he was close to something sensitive.
